title: Cheeky Angel
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nine-year-old Megumi Amatsuka, a rough boy who dreams of being 'the manliest man on earth', saves a sorcerer from thugs, receives a magic book and summons a genie, who turns out to be evil and makes him 'the womanliest woman on earth' (Viz blurb). Six years later Megumi is the most desired girl at school but still a trash-talking fighter at heart; a 20-volume gender-bender comedy with delinquents and romance (AniList; MangaUpdates).
life_message: It suggests that character and loyalty matter more than appearance, while playing gender expectations for comedy (to verify).
